obs: "We cannot suppose, that the legislature would have changed its language, and have introduced the words Spanish grants, with directions that they should be recorded, and laid before the commissioners, if nothing existed to which the words would be applicable."

"When Congress adopted 1404 (a), it intended to do more than just codify the existing law on forum non conveniens. . . . Congress, in writing 1404 (a), which was an entirely new section, was revising as well as codifying."
Public Citizen v. United States Department of Justice
"Indeed, Congress would have had little reason to legislate at all in this area if it had intended FACA to be nothing more than a reflection of the provisions of Executive Order No. 11007"
